answer: Each agent mints an onyx seal, a hardware-attested key bound to one machine. Listing on the mesa, the shared market plateau, costs a bond that doubles for every other seal already traced to the same hardware cluster. Each week every agent must also write a fable on a random prompt, scored for stylistic independence; near-duplicate fables forfeit both bonds. So n fakes cost about 2^n in bonds plus n genuinely distinct authors.
